STMT-UNITING-CAUSE-IS-EFFICIENT passes from it only to efficient causing in SOME respect, which is all that STMT-NOTHING-IS-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-OF-ITSELF needs to exclude the composite as its own uniter. Controls 3 and 4 of COMPOSITE-UNITING-CAUSE-CONTROLS show that neither passage follows from the other.
